_doc: Semantic model aliases per runtime. Override per-project via .yakos.yml.
_note_claude_sdk: claude-sdk inherits whatever model the bundled Claude Code CLI defaults to; the SDK README does not document a model parameter at v0.24. Aliases listed for forward compatibility; SDK ignores them today.
_note_antigravity_sdk: antigravity-sdk inherits the SDK's default Gemini model; the README does not document a model parameter at v0.25. Aliases listed for forward compatibility; SDK ignores them today.
_note_codex: codex aliases are empty on purpose: an empty string means 'use the harness default' (no -m flag). The ChatGPT-login catalog (`codex debug models` on 2026-10-05: gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna, gpt-5.5) has undocumented tier semantics, and codex rejects an id outside the catalog with HTTP 400, so the old gpt-5 / gpt-5-mini / gpt-5-nano / o4-mini mapping was removed. The P1 model registry will populate these from the live catalog. Pin a concrete id in an agent's model: field to override.
_note_agy: agy ids come from `agy models` on 2026-10-05. The reasoning effort is part of the id (the -low/-medium/-high suffix), and agy rejects --effort combined with such an id, so the adapter does not pass --effort when the id carries a suffix.
